name: plugin-quality
description: Post-use behavioral audit (plugin-quality:audit) of any Claude Code plugin skill, agent, hook, command, or config you have used. Six steps: capture evidence; map behavior in a fresh subagent that records errors, improvements, and quality-of-life items against standards; a blindspot pass; an interactive contract lock; review with a research gate on each finding's claims and fixes; and a confirmed work item for the maintainers. Uses context-guard snapshots when present.
